title: User Registration Success
description: Verify that a new user can register successfully with valid input data.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page (/auth/register).
Input valid username, email, password, and confirm password.
Click the register button.
Verify registration is successful and user is redirected to the dashboard (/dashboard).

title: User Registration with Invalid Email
description: Verify that registration fails with an invalid email format.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Input valid username and password but an invalid email format.
Attempt to register.
Verify error message is displayed for invalid email and registration is blocked.

title: User Login Success
description: Verify that a registered user can login successfully with correct credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page (/auth/login).
Enter valid email and password.
Click the login button.
Verify user is authenticated and redirected to dashboard (/dashboard).

title: User Login Failure - Incorrect Password
description: Verify that login fails when the password is incorrect.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid email and incorrect password.
Click the login button.
Verify error message is shown and user is not authenticated.

title: Password Recovery Flow
description: Verify that password recovery can be initiated and reset emails are sent appropriately.

steps.description: Navigate to the password recovery page (/auth/recover).
Enter a registered email address.
Submit the recovery request.
Verify confirmation message about email sent appears.
Use the password reset link from email to navigate to reset page.
Input valid new password and confirm password.
Submit password reset.
Verify password reset success message and ability to login with new password.

title: Dashboard Loads with No Trips
description: Verify that dashboard loads correctly and shows appropriate messages or empty states when the user has no upcoming trips.

steps.description: Login with a user account that has no trips.
Navigate to the dashboard (/dashboard).
Verify dashboard renders without errors and displays message indicating no upcoming trips.

title: Create New Trip
description: Verify that a user can create a new trip with valid input data and that the trip is persisted and visible in the trips list.

steps.description: Login and navigate to the trips module (/trips).
Click on create new trip.
Fill in required trip details including destination, dates, and notes.
Submit the new trip.
Verify the new trip appears in the trips list with correct details.

title: Edit Existing Trip
description: Verify that a user can edit existing trip details, save changes and the updates are reflected properly.

steps.description: Login and navigate to trips list.
Select an existing trip to edit.
Modify trip details and save changes.
Verify updated trip details persist and are accurately displayed.

title: Filter and Sort Trips
description: Verify that trips can be filtered by date, destination, or status and sorted properly in ascending and descending order.

steps.description: Navigate to trips listing page.
Apply filters: by date range, destination keyword, and trip status.
Change sorting between ascending and descending for each column.
Verify that the trips list updates correctly according to filter and sorting criteria.

title: Add, Edit and Remove Daily Activities
description: Verify that activities can be created, modified and deleted within the daily planning module linked to specific trips.

steps.description: Navigate to planning module for a selected trip.
Add a new activity with time, description and linked reservation.
Verify the activity is present with correct details.
Edit the activity's details.
Confirm that the updated activity information is saved and displayed.
Delete the activity.
Ensure the activity is removed from the list.

title: Register and Categorize Expenses per Trip
description: Verify that the user can add expenses linked to a trip with proper category assignment, currency selection and amount, and that totals are updated.

steps.description: Navigate to expenses page for a specific trip.
Add a new expense with category, description, amount and currency.
Verify that the expense appears in the list and totals are recalculated.

title: View Budget Analytics and Expense Breakdown
description: Verify the budget visualization component renders correctly with graphs and expenses analysis per category.

steps.description: Navigate to the budget/analytics page.
Ensure budget graphs load with correct data and are responsive.
Verify expense breakdown by category matches recorded expenses.

title: CRUD Notes with Tags and Favorites
description: Verify user can create, read, update and delete notes and organize notes via tags and mark notes as favorites.

steps.description: Navigate to notes section.
Create a new note with title, content and assign tags.
Verify the new note appears with correct tags.
Edit the note content and tags.
Confirm updated note reflects changes correctly.
Mark the note as favorite.
Verify the note appears in favorites filter.
Delete the note.
Verify the note is removed from the notes list.

title: Notification Panel - Display, Mark as Read, and Dismiss
description: Verify the alerts panel shows notifications, updates counter correctly, allows marking notifications as read and dismissing them.

steps.description: Trigger or wait for new notifications.
Open the alerts panel.
Verify notifications are listed with unread indicator and counter is accurate.
Mark one or more notifications as read.
Confirm unread counters update and notifications visually change state.
Dismiss one or multiple notifications.
Verify dismissed notifications disappear and are not shown again.

title: Route Protection and Authentication Middleware
description: Verify that private routes are protected and properly redirect unauthenticated users to login, and authenticated users have access without interruption.

steps.description: Attempt to access protected route (/dashboard) without authentication.
Verify user is redirected to login page (/auth).
Login with valid credentials.
Access the protected route again.
Verify user can access the protected route and content loads correctly.

title: Logout Functionality
description: Verify that a logged-in user can logout successfully and is redirected to the login or landing page.

steps.description: Login to the application.
Open the profile menu.
Click the logout button.
Verify user session is cleared and user is redirected to the login page (/auth).

title: Amadeus Flight Search Integration
description: Verify the flight search functionality calls Amadeus API, handles OAuth token correctly, caches token, and displays search results properly.

steps.description: Navigate to flight search page or module.
Enter valid flight search parameters (origin, destination, dates).
Submit the flight search request.
Verify API calls to Amadeus succeed and token caching mechanics are triggered.
Verify search results are displayed with correct flight details in UI.
Handle and display error messages gracefully if API returns errors or invalid responses.

title: UI Responsiveness and Accessibility
description: Verify that all main app pages and components render responsively on different screen sizes and support keyboard navigation and ARIA roles.

steps.description: Open the app pages (dashboard, trips, planning, expenses, notes, alerts) on desktop, tablet, and mobile viewport sizes.
Verify layout adjusts correctly without overlapping or clipping content.
Test keyboard navigation throughout pages and components.
Ensure focus states are visible, tab order is logical, and ARIA roles are present and correct.

title: Profile Update and Validation
description: Verify that authenticated users can update their profile information with valid input and changes persist.

steps.description: Login and open profile settings.
Update profile fields such as name, email, and password.
Submit profile updates.
Verify updates are saved and reflected in UI.
Attempt to update with invalid data such as malformed email.
Verify error messages appear and invalid submission is rejected.

title: Performance - Dashboard Load Time
description: Verify that dashboard loads within acceptable performance thresholds (e.g., under 2 seconds) with a typical user dataset.

steps.description: Login with a user having multiple trips, expenses, notes and notifications.
Measure page load time of dashboard (/dashboard).
Ensure dashboard loads completely within defined time limits.

title: Error Handling on API Failure
description: Verify the application properly handles backend API failures such as network errors or server errors with user-friendly feedback.

steps.description: Simulate backend API failure (e.g., 500 Internal Server Error) during trips fetch.
Navigate to trips page.
Verify appropriate error message is shown, UI remains stable without crash.

title: Logging Levels and Metrics Visibility
description: Verify that logging occurs at different levels, and visibility of logs and metrics matches configuration for authorized users only.

steps.description: Configure logging level to INFO.
Perform app operations to generate logs.
Verify INFO and above logs are recorded and viewable only by authorized users.
Change logging level to ERROR.
Verify only ERROR-level logs are recorded and visible.
